title: 10:00:00 AM · The Tatkal Rush
brief: It is 9:59:50 AM. Millions of railway passengers across India have their fingers poised on the Book button. At exactly 10:00:00 AM, the Tatkal ticket window unlocks and traffic spikes 15× in under 3 seconds.

event.description: Massive sudden surge of 6,000 req/s hitting the booking system.

prediction.prompt: At 10:00:00 AM when 6,000 req/s flood the system, which component will turn RED first?

misconceptions.cdn: The Edge CDN serves static images and CSS files. Dynamic Tatkal booking transactions bypass it completely!
misconceptions.payment_gateway: Payment processing is downstream. Most requests fail at the overloaded app tier long before ever reaching the bank.
misconceptions.seat_cache: Seat availability cache has high throughput (30,000 req/s) and can handle the load easily.
misconceptions.lb: The L7 Load Balancer has 100,000 req/s capacity and does not become the bottleneck.

palette.label: Enable Virtual Waiting Room
palette.description: Throttles incoming booking traffic to backend capacity using queue tokens.

palette.label: Scale App Server Pool
palette.description: Add 8 additional application server replicas (from 4 to 12).

palette.label: Enable Seat DB Read Replica
palette.description: Offload read queries to secondary database replica.
